sections.h2: How Do UAE Buyers Use AI Search?
sections.intro: The UAE is one of the most connected markets in the world, and many residents already use AI assistants at work and at home. A few patterns shape our strategy:

items.html: English first, Arabic too: most prompts are in English, but Arabic prompts matter for government suppliers, family businesses and Emirati consumers.
Shortlists, not searches: buyers ask AI to compare options ("top three", "best value", "most trusted"), then visit only those sites.
Local detail: prompts often include an area, such as Business Bay, Dubai Marina or Al Reem Island.
Mobile and voice: many questions are asked on phones, so answers need to be short and clear.

outro.text: That is why AI search optimisation UAE brands need covers both languages, local facts and concise, quotable content. It also explains why businesses with strong reviews and press coverage are often recommended ahead of larger competitors with weaker reputations online.

Reviews: Google reviews, plus sector platforms for clinics, hotels and restaurants.
